name: kneeling-dumbbell-hold-to-stand
instructions:
1. Set up in a tall kneeling position with both knees down.
2. Press a set of dumbbells overhead.
3. Lift one leg into a half kneeling split squat and drive up through the whole foot.
4. Stand up tall and then reverse the movement back to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
starting_position: 1. Set up in a tall kneeling position with both knees down. 2. Press a set of dumbbells overhead.
